Input image 1: original source for pixel style and original design details. Input image 2: FINAL CORRECTED STANDING FRONT MASTER, definitive face, body scale, clothing, palette and equipment sides. Input image 3: FINAL CORRECTED STANDING BACK MASTER, definitive rear hair, mantle, cape hem and reverse construction. Rotate this one SAME character between the front and back masters to the specified yaw; never turn the head alone. STAFF IS IN LEFT HAND, CASE ON RIGHT HIP, exactly as both corrected masters. Preserve the physical object arrangement through the rotation.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one individual eight-direction standing game-character sprite, on a genuinely transparent background.
Subject/design: reproduce the exact silver-haired staff character in the supplied source. Preserve the source's compact large-head/short-body game-sprite proportions and youthful face, long warm-silver layered wavy hair, small blue eyes, navy/royal-blue shoulder mantle and long cape with restrained gold floral borders, white tunic and white sleeves, dark forearm guards with gold edges, dark loose trousers, dark boots with gold fittings, small blue gemstone at the throat and belt, and a single slim navy staff with gold fittings and its tall asymmetric ivory-gold feathered wing crest and dark-blue curved ornament. Do not redesign clothing, add armor, add elf ears, duplicate weapons, or add unrelated magic effects.
Physical sides: staff held in the character's ANATOMICAL LEFT HAND; small navy cylindrical scroll case with gold endcaps on the ANATOMICAL RIGHT HIP. These sides are invariant as the character rotates, not screen-side labels. Right hand relaxed at the side. One staff only. The same asymmetrical staff crest rotates with the character, including a coherent reverse surface; do not simply mirror the design.
Pose: STANDING STILL in a relaxed upright idle pose, both feet planted on the same level floor, feet slightly separated, knees comfortably straight, weight balanced. Left hand grips a nearly vertical staff beside the left foot, staff butt reaches the floor. Right arm lowered naturally. Hair and cape hang with a gentle readable curve, no strong wind. No walking stride, stepping forward, running, lunging, jumping, crouching or attack. Whole head, torso, pelvis and feet rotate together to the specified yaw.
Style: match the provided source's detailed hand-drawn PIXEL ART, deliberate square pixel clusters and stepped edges, restrained indexed-looking color ramps, clean warm dark pixel outlines, controlled pixel highlights on metal and readable large cloth folds. Keep the compact proportions in this reference; do not convert to tall GC9/anime illustration, vector art, smooth painted shading, 3D render or photorealism. No blur or random noise.
Framing/camera: fixed orthographic game-character camera at the reference's elevation; only character yaw changes. One character and one view, centered on a square canvas matching the 1254x1254 master images. Same scale for all directions: staff crest near 6% from top, boot soles and staff butt at about 92% of image height, crown of the head around 25% from top. Entire staff crest, flowing hair, cape and both boots visible with clean padding. No perspective enlargement between directions.
Lighting/output: consistent gentle upper-left studio-style pixel light, matching palette in all views. True transparent alpha outside the silhouette, no black backdrop, no checkerboard painted into pixels, no floor plane, no cast-shadow ellipse, no labels, arrows, text, logo, border, extra panels or extra figures.

Requested direction for THIS FILE ONLY:
BACK-RIGHT THREE-QUARTER view, yaw 135 degrees: faces diagonally AWAY toward screen RIGHT. Back of head and cape dominant, narrow right-edge profile at most. No frontal chest, pair of eyes or front brooch on the back. LEFT-hand staff is on the FAR side and may be partly occluded by hair/cape, emerging toward screen LEFT; nearer RIGHT arm hangs empty, cylindrical case at near/right hip. All body parts rotate together.
calls.output_hint:
Generated images are saved to C:\Users\user\.codex\generated_images\01a1b01e-635e-7632-92af-039484dfcd8b as C:\Users\user\.codex\generated_images\01a1b01e-635e-7632-92af-039484dfcd8b\exec-28d61880-e359-41b9-bbf9-1856d9b54bc7.png by default.
If you need to use a generated image at another path, copy it and leave the original in place unless the user explicitly asks you to delete it.
The generated image is already displayed to the user. There is no need to render it in the final response as a Markdown image or file link.
